paper_title: Searching for Dark Matter with a Superconducting Qubit
notes: Dixit et al. (arXiv:2008.12231): hidden photon dark matter search using QND photon counting with a superconducting transmon qubit coupled to a 6.011 GHz (24.86 ueV) storage cavity. On-resonance limit epsilon <= 1.68e-15 at 90% CL with 8.33 s integration. The exclusion is extremely narrow-band: sensitivity falls to half maximum (-3 dB in power, so epsilon limit worsens by sqrt(2) to ~2.38e-15) at only 3 kHz (~1.2e-11 eV) from resonance; side points encode this. Additional weaker off-resonant sensitivity bands exist between ~6.000-6.022 GHz (Fig. 4 inset) but numerical values are not extractable from text.
